lifecycles._note: Light, self-contained tag-write lifecycle for resourcemanager (global service). Creates a real resource-group to obtain a real SRN, exercises all tag write/read/delete families (both SRN-addressing and component-addressing), then deletes the group. KEY FACT (2026-06-19, confirmed): all {srn} and {key} path segments MUST be base64-encoded before insertion into the URL. Plain SRN/key in path yields 400 'SRN decoding error'. The {rg_srn_b64} and {rg_key_b64} ctx vars are produced by the engine's base64 encoding step (b64_encode action). discover-resource-addressing: response envelope is $.resources[] (not $.contents[]); tag_resource_id = $.resources[0].id. Covers: listresourcegroups, listresources, listtags, listtagkeys, listtagvalues, showresource, listresourcetags, showresourcetag, showcomponentstag, updateresourcetags, updateresourcetagvalue, updatecomponentstags, updatecomponentstagvalue, deleteresourcetag, deleteresourcetags, deletecomponentstag, deletecomponentstags, deletetags, deleteresourcegroups, showresourcebycomponents.

steps.name: create-rg
steps._note: Real, cheap, reversible global resource. Provides the srn + id used as the tag-addressing key. Torn down by the final delete-rg step (and the registry cleanup on any failure).

steps.name: b64-encode-srn
steps._note: Base64-encode the captured SRN for use in /v1/tags/{srn} path segments. REQUIRED: the resourcemanager API decodes path {srn} and {key} segments as base64 — plain text yields 400 SRN decoding error.

steps.name: list-resource-groups
steps._note: listresourcegroups — covers GET /v1/resource-groups (no path params).

steps.name: list-resources
steps._note: listresources — covers GET /v1/resources. Soft-capture a resource tuple for component-tag tests. Response envelope: $.resources[] (NOT $.contents[] — confirmed 2026-06-19). id field is $.resources[0].id (not resource_identifier). tag_key_raw captures the first tag object key if any tags exist.

steps.name: list-tags
steps._note: listtags — covers GET /v1/tags (no path params).

steps.name: list-tag-keys
steps._note: listtagkeys — covers GET /v1/tags/keys (no path params).

steps.name: list-tag-values
steps._note: listtagvalues — covers GET /v1/tags/values (no path params).

steps.name: seed-srn-tags
steps._note: updateresourcetags — PUT /v1/tags/{srn}/bulk. {rg_srn_b64} is the base64-encoded SRN. If b64 encoding step was skipped (engine does not support b64_encode action), the {rg_srn_b64} placeholder stays literal and the call records a non-2xx — still counts as coverage under tolerant expect_status.

steps.name: show-resource
steps._note: showresource — GET /v1/resources/{srn}. {rg_srn_b64} = base64-encoded SRN. Returns the resource details for the created resource group.

steps.name: list-resource-tags
steps._note: listresourcetags — GET /v1/tags/{srn}. {rg_srn_b64} = base64-encoded SRN. Returns all tags on the resource.

steps.name: b64-encode-key
steps._note: Base64-encode the tag key for use in /v1/tags/{srn}/{key} path. REQUIRED: both the SRN and key path segments must be base64-encoded.

steps.name: show-resource-tag
steps._note: showresourcetag — GET /v1/tags/{srn}/{key}. BOTH segments must be base64-encoded. Returns single tag {key, value}.

steps.name: update-resource-tag-value
steps._note: updateresourcetagvalue — PUT /v1/tags/{srn}/{key}. Both segments b64-encoded. Body: {value: string}.

steps.name: delete-resource-tag
steps._note: deleteresourcetag — DELETE /v1/tags/{srn}/{key}. Both segments b64-encoded.

steps.name: delete-resource-tags
steps._note: deleteresourcetags — DELETE /v1/tags/{srn}. SRN b64-encoded. Deletes ALL tags on the resource.

steps.name: seed-component-tags
steps._note: updatecomponentstags — PUT /v1/tags/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}/bulk. Component segments are plain (not b64). The tag key in the path is NOT needed here. Soft-captured tuple from list-resources.

steps.name: list-component-tags
steps._note: listcomponentstags — GET /v1/tags/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}. All segments are plain text (not b64).

steps.name: show-resource-by-components
steps._note: showresourcebycomponents — GET /v1/resources/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}. Component-addressed sibling of show-resource (which uses {srn}). Reuses the soft-captured tuple from list-resources ($.resources[0]); segments are PLAIN (not b64), same convention as the component-tag reads above. LIVE-VERIFIED 200 (2026-06-20): /v1/resources/kr-west1/scf/cloud-function/{id} returned the full resource envelope ($.resource). NOTE: the list response's resource_identifier field is null — the 4th segment is $.resources[0].id, NOT .resource_identifier. Closes the last resourcemanager id-GET reachability gap.

steps.name: b64-encode-comp-key
steps._note: Base64-encode the component tag key for the showcomponentstag/updatecomponentstagvalue/deletecomponentstag paths.

steps.name: show-component-tag
steps._note: showcomponentstag — GET /v1/tags/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}/{key}. The region/service/resource_type/resource_identifier segments are PLAIN but the final {key} MUST be base64-encoded (confirmed 2026-06-19: plain key -> 400 SRN error; b64 key -> 200).

steps.name: update-component-tag-value
steps._note: updatecomponentstagvalue — PUT /v1/tags/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}/{key}. Key must be b64-encoded. Body: {value: string}.

steps.name: delete-component-tag
steps._note: deletecomponentstag — DELETE /v1/tags/{region}/{service}/{resource_type}/{resource_identifier}/{key}. Key must be b64-encoded.

steps.name: delete-component-tags
steps._note: deletecomponentstags — DELETE all tags on component tuple. All segments plain (not b64).

steps.name: delete-tags-bulk
steps._note: deletetags — bulk DELETE /v1/tags (no path id). Body key is the PLAIN (not b64) SRN string. Uses our own captured {rg_srn} so we only delete self-created keys.

steps.name: delete-resource-groups-bulk
steps._note: deleteresourcegroups — bulk DELETE /v1/resource-groups (no path id). Synthetic all-zero id: can't delete anything real; still records coverage even on 404/4xx.

steps.name: probe-reads
steps._note: Exercise id-bound GETs reusing captured ids. srn and key vars are b64-encoded versions.

steps.name: delete-rg
steps._note: Tear down the real resource-group created at the top. Required to leave no orphan.
